subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): rename SSH_DotNet classes to PascalCase (S101)
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): rename SSH_DotNet classes to PascalCase (S101)

Rename the five SonarCloud S101-flagged types (and their files) to PascalCase:
  ProtocolSSH_DotNet        -> ProtocolSshDotNet
  SSHAuthenticationProvider -> SshAuthenticationProvider
  SSHConnectionManager      -> SshConnectionManager
  SSHTunnelManager          -> SshTunnelManager
  SSHDotNetDiagnostics      -> SshDotNetDiagnostics
Test fixtures and files renamed in lock-step for consistency. All references
updated (ProtocolFactory, ConnectionInitiator, tests, etc.).

Namespace/folder (SSH_DotNet) and the ProtocolType enum value + serialized
strings are renamed in the following sub-steps.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: The SSH_DotNet protocol is an unmerged, obsolete experimental feature that does not exist in our fork; we use OpenSSH instead.
